scope: Thirteen public repositories: twelve runtime-source repairs and one independent test/review follow-up.
counting_policy: Local, CI matrix, quality, and review suites overlap. Their test counts must not be added together.
scientific_boundary: Engineering verification only. Retained scientific results and their original conclusions are preserved; no new study completion or submission readiness is asserted.

repositories.name: World Series
repositories.change: Reject duplicate configuration keys, boolean seeds and nonfinite JSON evidence before publishing or replacing files.
repositories.verification: 182 local tests; full hosted implementation checks, wheel build and CLI doctor passed.
repositories.scientific_boundary: All nine modules share the repaired execution layer. This verifies software and evidence contracts; no new scientific campaign was run.

repositories.name: NeuroCAD
repositories.change: Prevent integer wraparound, norm overflow and nonzero product underflow from producing invalid linear solve diagnostics.
repositories.verification: 69 focused local cases; all ten CI jobs and CAD/Gmsh integration passed. Python 3.11: 1,229 passed/9 skipped; Python 3.12 source distribution: 1,226 passed/9 skipped.
repositories.scientific_boundary: Unrepresentable diagnostics fail closed. Geometry, providers, retained research results and scientific claims are unchanged.

repositories.name: FIM
repositories.change: Restore mixed submodule evaluation modes and recover GradScaler state after a rejected nonfinite gradient.
repositories.verification: 21 focused local and independent passes; hosted 197 passed, 7 skipped and 10 subtests.
repositories.scientific_boundary: Protected trajectory evaluation remained skipped. Existing failed and negative research outcomes are preserved.

repositories.name: LAM-JEPA
repositories.change: Reject nonfinite or incompatible checkpoint tensors before strict inference loading, while preserving RNG isolation.
repositories.verification: 57 local and exact-source hosted tests; all six triggered workflows succeeded.
repositories.scientific_boundary: Checkpoint admission and inference correctness do not establish model effectiveness or new scientific evidence.

repositories.name: RIPII
repositories.change: Reject ambiguous duplicate-member NPZ inputs and exclusively publish complete prediction archives without overwriting existing evidence.
repositories.verification: 10 focused local cases; 258 hosted passes on each Python 3.10/3.11/3.12. Coverage 80.98% against the unchanged 75% gate.
repositories.scientific_boundary: Historical archives and scientific conclusions remain intact; the publication protocol requires trusted parent directories.

repositories.name: RIS
repositories.change: Preserve the concurrent actual-displacement Hessian correction and add three independent analytical test methods plus a review/state record.
repositories.verification: 20 local, independent and exact-source hosted test methods passed.
repositories.scientific_boundary: Runtime source was authored concurrently in 0175f756759cdd99b28db1c0b4acaa38a563ca50. This pass authored only tests and review/state records; no scientific-result claim is added.

repositories.name: FI-JEPA
repositories.change: Validate normalization inputs and fitted state, make refits transactional, and avoid overflow on finite training panels.
repositories.verification: 57 hosted tests passed, with 3 recorded warnings; ordinary float32 behavior and empty transform compatibility remain covered.
repositories.scientific_boundary: Temporal separation and frozen evidence are preserved; no market-effectiveness claim is made.

repositories.name: Eigen-JEPA
repositories.change: Validate and consume the same immutable CSV snapshot, reject malformed spectral inputs, and bind exact source bytes.
repositories.verification: 138 hosted tests plus 6 claim-boundary tests passed. The rigor gate correctly rejects one retained seed when three are required.
repositories.scientific_boundary: The prospective path preserves five frozen source bindings. Under-seeded evidence remains insufficient for paper-facing rigor claims.

repositories.name: GaussianMemory
repositories.change: Retain source/configuration manifests, completed-step journals and failure/interruption receipts for training.
repositories.verification: 38 hosted tests plus compilation, bounded train/eval CLI smoke and evidence sentinel passed.
repositories.scientific_boundary: The bounded smoke establishes entrypoint operation. Scientific training, generalization and model-comparison claims remain unestablished.

repositories.name: IRIS
repositories.change: Reject duplicate, nonfinite and nonobject JSON before exact development-record replay and bind the consumed byte snapshot.
repositories.verification: 113 exact-source hosted tests; five existing bounded development scenarios and protected-ID rejection passed.
repositories.scientific_boundary: Protected IDs 1000–1029 remain closed. The scientific generator and retained source-bound records are unchanged.

repositories.name: IRIS-Space
repositories.change: Remove zero-quaternion gradient NaNs, select the actual last valid token, and prevent nonfinite padding from poisoning valid representations.
repositories.verification: 75 exact-source preparation tests; broad CI 741 tests plus 129 subtests on each Python 3.11–3.14, with security, format/lint, mypy and packaging passed.
repositories.scientific_boundary: Checkpoint schema advances explicitly to v2 and rejects incompatible v1 checkpoints. Preparation and development verification do not establish protected-test success.

repositories.name: EPU
repositories.change: Convert NumPy integer scalars to exact Python integers before signed fixed-point rounding to avoid overflow and unsigned wraparound.
repositories.verification: 21 exact-source hosted tests plus an eight-step Icarus Verilog parity check passed, including exact fixed-point agreement.
repositories.scientific_boundary: A bounded parity trace is verified; hardware performance and broader scientific effectiveness are not inferred.

repositories.name: EigenFinance offline proposal
repositories.change: Preserve representable subnormal covariance-error totals and means, and reject nonzero losses below the output range.
repositories.verification: 25 exact-source hosted tests and independent numerical checks passed. A narrow push trigger verifies this exact draft branch.
repositories.scientific_boundary: This remains an unactivated offline stacked proposal. Stale mergeability metadata is retained separately; no PR/base merge was performed.
